scope: Whole original OBJ metadata and edge-versus-vertex source connectivity; no body/hardware classification by component size
metadata: Read every o/g/usemtl/mtllib/comment tag, retain raw names and face spans privately, and compare every original OBJ face index to the frozen decoded triangle array. Publish counts and hashes only.
topology: Preserve all original indexed faces including the eight degenerate faces. Compute face components by shared indexed edges and vertex components separately. Do not weld coincident positions or remove small components.
independence: Python packed-edge ordering plus SciPy sparse components; separate C++ pair-of-endpoints ordering plus disjoint sets, including a fresh original OBJ face/metadata parse. Compare complete partitions up to label bijection.
seed_mapping: Map all eight fixed chamber selections into whole-source components without assigning physical identities.
controls: shared vertex without edge separates face components
execution: Owner Kali1, existing verified original/arrays and scientific Python runtime; native Linux filesystem; private new output root; no paid compute.
